name: glowbook
description: GlowBook — Production-Quality Salon & Spa Booking Platform

scripts.db:setup: cp -n apps/api/.env.example apps/api/.env && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx prisma db seed
